form.title: Create a support ticket
form.description: Tell us what's going on. We'll reply here and by email.
form.subject: Subject
form.subjectPlaceholder: E.g. WhatsApp messages are not arriving
form.bodyPlaceholder: Describe the problem, what you expected and the steps to reproduce it.
form.created: Ticket #{n} created. We'll let you know when we reply.

page.title: Support
page.subtitle: Your tickets with the support team.
page.closed: This ticket is closed. Replying reopens it.
page.select: Pick a ticket to see the conversation.

errors.invalid_subject: The subject must be 3 to 160 characters.
errors.generic: The action could not be completed.

welcome.title: Welcome to Whasalia! 👋
welcome.body: Here's a one-minute tour of where everything is. Replay it anytime from the compass icon at the top.

workspace.title: Your business
workspace.body: Switch businesses here if you manage more than one.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.body: Your business at a glance: conversations, contacts, sales and your AI tokens.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.body: Every conversation from WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and your website in one place. Reply, assign and tag.

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.body: Your customer base with history, tags and notes.

pipelines.title: Pipelines
pipelines.body: Track every sales opportunity by stage, from first contact to close.

channels.title: Channels
channels.body: Connect your WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger or website chat here. It's the first step to start receiving messages.

agents.title: AI agents
agents.body: Create agents that reply for you, train them (FAQs too) and review what they answered in the AI log.

business.title: Your business
business.body: Bookings, catalog, orders and your team, depending on your type of business.

reports.title: Reports
reports.body: Response times, volume per channel, team and AI performance.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Your team, templates, tags, quick replies, token top-ups and business setup (hours, details).

tourIcon.title: Replay the tour
tourIcon.body: Click here whenever you want to see this guide again.

help.title: Need help?
help.body: Open a ticket or chat live with our support team from here.

supportAdmin.title: Support tickets
supportAdmin.subtitle: Requests from businesses. Reply here: the customer gets a bell notification and an email.
supportAdmin.replyPlaceholder: Write the reply to the customer…

settings.title: Customer support
settings.subtitle: How businesses reach you from the "?" button.
settings.chatHelp: Pick a web chat channel of your own support business. Messages land in that inbox, where you or an AI agent can reply.
settings.whatsappHelp: Without live chat, the button opens WhatsApp with this number. Digits only, with country code.
settings.email: New tickets are emailed to the support address in the "Agency" section.
